race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
race.verdict: SELOSSE seemed unsuited by conditions at Naas and is well worth another chance now fitted with cheekpieces given the strength of his debut form. Warrior of Siam seems sure to benefit from the experience of his first run here a fortnight ago and is a big danger. Bridgetown Boy and the steadily progressive Golden Idol complete the shortlist. SELOSSE (IRE) WARRIOR OF SIAM (IRE) BRIDGETOWN BOY (FR)
